# `base64` standard library

The `base64` module implements RFC 4648 Section 4 standard Base64 (`+`, `/`, `=`
padding) and Section 5 URL/filename-safe Base64URL (`-`, `_`, unpadded),
parameterized by `base64::Flavor` (`< Std, Url >`).

```{.dva .run}
#use base64
#use io

enc = base64::encode("hello world", base64::Flavor::Std)
io::out $ enc
base64::decode(enc, base64::Flavor::Std) | dec => io::out $ dec
```

## Types and function catalog

| Symbol / Function | Signature | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `base64::Flavor` | `< Std, Url >` | Alphabet and padding variant (`Std`: `+/=`, `Url`: `-_` unpadded) |
| `base64::encode(bytes, flavor)` | `String, Flavor => String` | Encodes `bytes` into Base64 (`Std` pads with `=`; `Url` is unpadded) |
| `base64::decode(s, flavor)` | `String, Flavor => < String | Error >` | Decodes Base64 (ignoring ASCII whitespace; `Url` accepts padded or unpadded) |
| `base64::from_int(n, len, flavor)` | `Int, Int, Flavor => String` | Encodes `n` as `len` Base64 sextet characters (most-significant sextet first) |
| `base64::to_int(s, flavor)` | `String, Flavor => < Int | >` | Decodes unpadded Base64 sextet characters into an `Int` |
| `base64::is_valid(s, flavor)` | `String, Flavor => <>` | Returns `<+>` when `s` is non-empty and consists strictly of valid alphabet chars |
| `base64::char(idx, flavor)` | `Int, Flavor => Int` | Maps 6-bit value `0..63` to its ASCII character for `flavor` |
| `base64::val(c, flavor)` | `Int, Flavor => Int` | Maps ASCII character `c` to `0..63` for `flavor`, or `-1` if invalid |
